item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A cold front is expected to move across Guangdong during the weekend, the weather will be cold over the region early next week. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon and its replenishment, it will be cloudy and rainy with weather remaining rather cool over the coast of southern China during the Lunar New Year holidays.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
